content.short: Hodl My Moon is a Polygon NFT Marketplace and Social Network.
content.description: Hodl My Moon provides a fast and easy way to mint, buy, and sell Polygon NFTs. Every post on the platform is an NFT, and avatars themselves are NFTs. The app connects NFT creators to their communities, while fans can like and comment on the NFTs you share. No programming knowledge is required. Crop, filter, and upload assets easily from desktop or mobile, then select an asset, set a license, and mint to bring your NFT into the ecosystem.
content.meta: Hodl My Moon provides a fast and easy way for users to mint, buy, and sell Polygon NFTs. Discover Hodl My Moon and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
